classified: test/factory/*.t.sol — the source-version suites needed for the factory pilot, at the top level of the directory only
test/deployed-factories/FusionFactoryEthereum.t.sol — unchanged deployed-usage coverage for the Ethereum pilot

test/fuses/<integration>/ and test/unitTest/fuses/<integration>/ local suites of the catalogued integrations (group fuses-local): Aave V4, Agua, async action, Euler V2, external state, Midas, Term Finance, transient storage, universal token swapper, update balances, burn request fee and the fuse whitelist — every file that deploys everything itself and reads no RPC; run 2026-09-09, 57 suites, 1476 tests, all passing under factory_local
scope.unclassified: Everything else under test/, including test/factory/price_feed/, any other file under test/deployed-factories/ and every fork suite of the integrations listed above, is deliberately not classified yet. An unlisted suite carries no claim in either direction: read its setUp() before quoting a result, and do not treat its absence here as evidence that it is local, that it forks, or that it is unnecessary. Suites are added one area at a time, each with the run that produced its numbers.

suites.proves: At Ethereum block 25937526, a vault created by the unchanged factory can be configured for the catalogued ERC4626 market with the deployed fuses and then carry a full asset cycle: deposit, supply into Steakhouse USDC through ALPHA_ROLE, exit back and redeem, with total assets preserved within 1 USDC on 100000 and the 50% market limit enforced.

suites.proves: At Ethereum block 25937526, a permissionless caller can create an ERC4626 price feed through the unchanged deployed factory; the feed points at the requested vault, reports 18 decimals and returns a price that equals the value recomputed from convertToAssets and the middleware's USDC price to within 1 wei, while a non-ERC4626 address is rejected.
suites.doesNotProve: That the deployed implementation is the code in this checkout, that the feed behaves the same for other vaults or assets, that a feed registered in a vault's price manager is configured correctly, or that any transaction should be broadcast.
